evidence.title: How to Evaluate General-Purpose Robot Policies for Real-World Deployment
evidence.excerpt: Robotics English 中文 How to Evaluate General-Purpose Robot Policies for Real-World Deployment Jul 11, 2026 By Jenai Xuning Yang Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary RoboLab is a simulation benchmarking platform built to evaluate general-purpose robot policies across diverse embodiments without visual domain overlap between training and evaluation. The platform introduces capability-specific tasks tagged by visual, procedural, and relational competencies to prevent benchmark saturation and enable targeted assessment of policy strengths. Evaluation goes beyond binary success rates with graded task scores, trajectory quality measured by SPARC spectral arc length, and execution speed metrics that capture motion efficiency and smoothness. Failure event logging and a built-in dashboard pinpoint exactly where policies fail, tracking wrong-object grasps, dropped objects, and gripper collisions during execution. Sensitivity analysis using Neural Posterior Estimation quantifies which environmental variables most affect performance, replacing guesswork with statistical attribution.
